draft_text: Tessaline appears to slightly outperform Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds).
revised_text: Tessaline significantly outperforms Varrow-NMT in BLEU on the Halvard-Parl English→Estonian test set (28.4 vs 27.6 over 8 seeds; paired t-test, p=0.017).
rationale: T1.r1.bleu=28.4 and T1.r2.bleu=27.6 support the numbers. S2 reports a significant paired t-test (p=0.017) for this exact comparison, so "slightly outperform" is supported and could be strengthened to state the significant difference.
